title: Town population rules: count only living housed residents, day-only move-ins, respawn at dawn
player_outcome: New residents only arrive during the day. Dead residents, the Old Man and bound NPCs no longer count toward requirements like 'needs N residents'. A slain resident returns the next morning instead of after a fixed 6-minute timer.
design: Verified: TownSystem.cs:67 runs move-in checks at any hour. TownSystem.cs:141 counts every resident, dead ones and the Old Man included. TownSystem.Movement.cs:16-19 revives purely by RespawnTicks (21600). EventDirector.cs:130 builds its own resident set.

Move ShopEntry, DialogueLine and MoodEntry out of TownNpcDef.cs into a new TownNpcParts.cs to make room for later fields. Add enum TownNpcKind {Resident, Landmark} (later WPs add Visitor and Pet) and a [JsonIgnore] TownNpcDef.Kind derived from Landmark.
TownNpc: add Bound (bool), DiedAtTick (long, -1), CountsAsResident => Alive && !Bound && Def.Kind == Resident, and IsHoused => CountsAsResident && Home != null.

ConditionContext gets a ResidentCount (int) field, and the 'residents' condition in ConditionCompiler reads ResidentCount instead of Residents.Count. Add TownSystem.FillTownFacts(ctx): Residents = ids of CountsAsResident residents; ResidentCount = number of IsHoused residents. TownContext and EventDirector.Roll both call it.

TownSystem.CheckArrivals(bool force = false): homeless residents are re-housed at any hour, but new arrivals need force || Clock.IsDay. Tick passes false. The 'town check [force]' subcommand passes force.

New TownSystem.Life.cs partial: move Revive and Vanish here and add ShouldRevive(r). When TownConfig.RespawnAtDawn is set, revive once Tick >= the first dawn after DiedAtTick and Tick - DiedAtTick >= MinDeadTicks. The first dawn is dayStart + DawnHour*TicksPerHour, plus one day if the death came after that dawn. Otherwise keep the RespawnTicks delay. Damage() and Vanish() set DiedAtTick.
WorldMeta.ResidentModel: append the optional ctor params Bound = false and DiedAt = -1. System.Text.Json fills in defaults, so no version bump. Update Persist/Load to match.

TownCommands: add 'town slay <id>' (calls TownSystem.Slay) for smoke scripts. Keep TownCommands.cs under 150 lines by putting the new debug subcommands in a new TownDebugCommands.cs registered from TownCommands.Register.

risks: The party event (EventDirector) now sees only residents who count, so a party cannot start while the Party Girl is dead. That is intended.
The Old Man's Vanish now returns him at the next dawn instead of after 6 minutes, which is closer to Terraria.
